column3: Close to the Greek; “made a wedding feast” is rendered “arranged a marriage.”
Close to the Greek; “paid no attention” is rendered “made light of it.”
Close to the Greek; “those reclining” is rendered “guests.”
NKJV has “Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and cast him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Having bound his feet and hands, cast him out.”
Close to the Greek; “tribute” is rendered “taxes.”
Close to the Greek; “the coin of the tribute” is rendered “the tax money.”
NKJV has “angels of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “angels.”
